newsitem.title: USA: Newpark Resources to buy two fluids companies.
newsitem.headline: Newpark Resources to buy two fluids companies.

text.p: Newpark Resources Inc said on Tuesday it plans to acquire two privately-held drilling fluids-related companies in exchange for 130,000 shares of Newpark common stock.
In the first transaction, Newpark said it will acquire Advanced Chemical Technologies Inc, a Houston-based drilling fluids company, for 60,000 shares of Newpark common stock.

In the second, Newpark said it will acquire Chem-Energy Ltd, a Houston-based provider of specialty blended chemical products used in drilling fluids, in exchange for 70,000 shares of Newpark common stock.
Newpark, which supplies oilfield and environmental services, said it expects to account for both transactions as a poolings of interest and to close early in July.
